title: Consular Support for Singaporeans Arrested or Charged with Offences in Foreign Countries
what_it_is: Consular Support for Singaporeans Arrested or Charged with Offences in Foreign Countries

sections.label: MFA consular assistance for detained Singaporeans
sections.summary: MFA prioritises overseas Singaporeans' safety and provides consular assistance determined by each case's circumstances and host country obligations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The safety of Singaporeans who are travelling overseas is always the paramount concern of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: If a Singaporean is arrested or detained, we ensure that our citizens are accorded due process under those local laws.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Hence, the extent and the nature of our consular assistance are determined by the unique circumstances of each case and, of course, by the bilateral and international obligations of the host country.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Once MFA is notified that a Singaporean has been arrested or detained overseas, we will quickly get in touch with the next-of-kin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will also contact the local authorities to ascertain the basic facts of the case.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will request for consular access to the Singaporean and we will facilitate visits by the next-of-kin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: MFA will also continue to seek updates from the local authorities on the progress of the case and we will remain in contact with his next-of-kin and family members in order to provide consular assistance.
